# Falaw Advogados

Official website: https://falaw.com.br/
Primary language: pt-BR (English switch available on page)

## About
Falaw Advogados is a law firm focused on Brazilian labor and employment law, with strong practice in startups, technology companies, labor litigation, legal compliance, and labor relations.

## Core services
- Labor litigation and strategic defense
- Employment advisory (consultivo trabalhista)
- Labor compliance and preventive audits
- Union and labor relations
- Legal operations for high-volume labor matters
- Training and corporate education in labor law

## Coverage
- Based in Sao Paulo, Brazil
- Serves companies nationwide
